opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to paste externally hosted smart-contract code into Remix, deploy it, and fund the contract with BNB to snipe liquidity pools. It describes a bot that front-runs pending transactions, while asserting that greater funding enables larger trades and greater profits. It further promises that 90% of profit returns to the wallet, cites weeks producing 7 to 8 BNB, and claims profitability about 95% of the time. Those are concrete inducements to deploy and fund a trading contract based on highly favorable returns. The presentation does acknowledge that some contracts may be unprofitable and that fees can exceed returns, but those qualifications do not remove the central profit-driven solicitation.
